title: Google\Cloud\BigQuery\DataTransfer\V1\StartBigQueryJobsRequest
name: StartBigQueryJobsRequest
description: A request to start and monitor a BigQuery load job.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: Name of the resource in the form: "projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}/transferConfigs/{config_id}/runs/{run_id}"

params.name: data.imported_data
params.description: Import jobs which should be started and monitored.

params.name: data.user_credentials
params.description: User credentials which should be used to start/monitor BigQuery jobs. If not specified, then jobs are started using data source service account credentials. This may be OAuth token or JWT token.

params.name: data.max_parallelism
params.description: The number of BQ Jobs that can run in parallel.
